instruction_quality.task_summary: The agent must reverse-engineer a reference.mp4 showing a central circle with 6 orbiting satellites across 3 animation phases, and recreate it algorithmically in scene.py using MoviePy primitives. The rendered output.mp4 must match the reference video.

Grep blocks cv2.VideoCapture, open(), subprocess, exec/eval, base64, importlib, and 30+ other patterns in scene.py
Numeric literal count, flat array size, string literal length, and total string chars are bounded by per-task thresholds derived from oracle solution

reward_design.formula_explanation: Multiplicative aggregation of visual similarity, perceptual hash match, and frame count alignment ensures all dimensions must be high for a non-trivial score.

components.name: gated_ssim
components.metric: RGB SSIM averaged over 60 sampled frames with temporal offset search, gated at 0.70, cubic scaling above gate: ((mean_ssim - 0.70) / 0.30)^3

components.name: phash_similarity
components.metric: Per-frame 64-bit DCT perceptual hash, mean Hamming distance normalized to [0,1] as 1 - dist/32

components.name: duration_penalty
components.metric: Frame count ratio agent/reference, linear ramp within [0.75, 1.25], hard fail outside

dimension_analysis.name: gated_ssim
dimension_analysis.notes: Requires high pixel-level visual match across 60 frames with cubic scaling making high scores very demanding.

dimension_analysis.name: phash_similarity
dimension_analysis.notes: Perceptual hash catches structural layout differences; correlates with SSIM but provides independent structural validation.

dimension_analysis.name: duration_penalty
dimension_analysis.notes: Matching frame count is straightforward once animation logic is roughly correct, but cannot compensate for visual mismatch due to multiplicative aggregation.
